rationale: Ahmad is architecting a new category of AI-native hardware at Midjourney that integrates deeply with generative AI models, while Manish brings Staff-level ML infrastructure and computer-vision expertise from Meta and Palo Alto Networks—skills directly relevant to the ML systems and vision pipelines that would power next-gen AI hardware interfaces. Both are in San Francisco and their complementary backgrounds (hardware systems + ML infrastructure) map cleanly to the cross-disciplinary challenge of embedding sophisticated AI models into novel form factors.
intro_message: Ahmad Abbas, meet Manish Kumar Keshri — you're both solving the hardware–AI integration problem from opposite ends, and his ML infrastructure + computer-vision work at Meta could be useful context for the AI-native hardware category you're pioneering at Midjourney.
